[b]Signing of the Reditus Decretum[/b]

The heat swells outside the senate building in midday, inside the building houses a chaotic hearing with words being sprang up left and right, but all tie back to one idea, the reconquest of Sanguivallis' former territories. A senator stands up in passion inside the dimly lit, tobacco reeking, semi circle building, "Your excellency, ever since the Ventusian council in 1999 every single major city defected from the republic with fears and skepticism of the new system! Sanguivallis has been stripped naked of her armor, we are nothing but a little sovereign state with one major city, I mean, Ottominus defected in 1999 as well! The very birth right of the nation when our great great grandfathers shed their blood during the Old Kingdom! Whats Sanguivallis when Ventusia has not its sister city Ottominus? The city lies not far from here and we shall take the initiative to retake it!" the senator shouts in patriotism, the building all groaning in agreement. Another senator stands up, opposing the previous one, "The initiative taken by Sanguivallis has been one of peace and tranqulity, you dare break that? How inappropriate of you to suggest a warmongering mindset infront of our Lord!" The senator says as he gestures to the massive crucifix situated behind where the consul sat and where all the senators faced. "If the Lord, blessed be his name, would have opposed such ideals then he would have struck me down already!" He retorted back, the senate raising their voice in agreement, "I know for a fact that the Lord supports me, and those who support the idea as a whole, those cities were ours to begin with ever SINCE the very foundation of our glorious motherland!" He patriotically declared with his voice raising with every word, "Your excellency," he turns back facing the consul, grabbing a piece of paper which was hidden inside his jacket's breast pocket, "I have in my right hand, the very decree that would hereby give Sanguivallis the power to regain her lost territories, all of them, legitimate claims traced back to the very times of our great ancestors, cities like Ottominus belongs to Sanguivallis and Sanguivallis alone!", he says taking a moment to regain his composure. "I ask of you one thing, and it is to sign it."

"I admire your patriotism dear senator, but let us not carelessly throw the Lord's name like a plaything." The consul says as he signs the paper, "Although we in the upper house hold power, it is up to those in the Lower house of the people's representatives to sign it. But from here, I hereby sign your decree senator, The Reditus Decritum!" He declared.

Abiding by tradition, the consul took the piece of paper and stood up, addressing the senate, and with a raised voice he spoke with thunder in his voice. "Since the council in 1999, plenty cities which was once under Sanguivallis defected from the control of the country. It is only right, therefore, for Sanguivallis itself to gain claims to these cities which were once under her, whether they have fallen, defected to neighbouring countries, or still exist independently. Although knowledge of them to most countries may be sparce, these cities were Ventusia's siblings and were founded WITH her during the very foundation of Sanguivallis during the Romanicusian Empire. This decree hereby claims the once sanguinian cities of Ottominus, Revini, Meridiem, and Oceanium. As consul, I, Mariano Abecci, under the witness of our Lord, Jesus Christ, hereby proclaim and confirm these claims and will refer to this decree whenever in the need to. As consul, I, Mariano Abecci, promise to uphold what is said in this decree and dare not to cheat it." He took his right hand and turned before the massive crucifix, and solemnly declared "I hereby approve the passage of this decree and pass it down to the Lower House of the People's Representatives."

As soon as the consul finished speaking, the entire senate erupted in applause and cheer for 2 minutes before settling down.

5 days later, after the senate hearing and after the decree was approved by the lower house and  set into motion by the consul and his office, it was met with some negative feedback on social media and some fake news criticizing the regime of turning fascist, most people either supported it or didn't care. And so, the consul put together a force of 5,300 men strong as an expedition force to check how the old city of Ottominus was doing. They were sent south of the capital city of Ventusia, exiting the valley.

[b]DIAMONDS ARE FOREVER[/b]
[i]1: Surface Search[/i]]
In the early hours of the morning, a helicopter flies high over the endless expanse of Argosian desert. All around it, the landscape is the same - rolling dunes of red sand, their colour accentuated by the deep orange glow of the rising sun in the east.

Inside the helicopter is a crew of 5 prospectors from New Westmore, who were sent by the nation's largest mining company, BMG. They have been in the air for more than 6 hours, and are bound for the nation of Alkiragunya to investigate if the rumours of there being a large untapped diamond reserve in the country's south have any weight to them at all. Upon arrival, they cannot expect any help from the locals; most of them live nomadic lifestyles, and if there happen to be locals in the area they are investigating, they will more than likely run from the Westmorians out of fear or even bewilderment at how technologically advanced they are compared to them.

One of the prospectors wake up. [i]"Urgh... Uh, Randall, how far are we from the dig site?"[/i]

The pilot hears the prospector, and responds to his question. [i]"Yeah, we're not far from it now, mate. I reckon we'll be on the ground in about 5 to 10 minutes; maybe wake up your buddies now so they can get ready for our arrival."[/i]

The prospector nods, and starts stirring his coworkers awake. Within the next 5 minutes, the helicopter begins to make its descent to their dig site.

The dig site looks absolutely unremarkable. It is a relatively flat plain covered in fine red sand, of course. Nearby, there's a small oasis, surrounded by a thick grove of trees and shrubs. The helicopter pilot decides to land near the oasis, so that the prospectors can set up their base of operations near a place that can provide adequate relief from the unforgiving heat of the sun. Once the helicopter comes to a stop, the prospectors disembark with all of their equipment, and begin the long and arduous search for these near-mythical diamonds.[/spoiler]

[spoiler][b]The Nordiheimian and Alkiragunyan Trade and Friendship Agreement of 2025[/b]

[u][b]Trade[/b][/u]

1. The main place of trade will be done at 'Traders point' located in traders corridor near the Alkiragunya border.
2. Alkiragunya will supply 15'000 camels and a stable supply of copper Nordiheim.
3. Nordiheim will inn return supply iron, steel and steel tools/equipment of not only equal vallue but also the combination that Alkiragunya desires.
4. What constitutes as 'equal vallue' must be agreed by both parties without any form of force or unfair cohersion or knowledge.
5a. The combinations of trade goods will be decided/altered on a 6 month basis.
5b. The amount and type of goods can only be altered outside these 6 month intervals by the combined agreement between both nations ruling bodies.

[u][b]Aditional Trade opportuneties[/b][/u]

1. Additional trade opportuneties can be done on smaller scale between traders on a day to day basis, both at 'Traders point' and other places in the two nations.
2. These trades must follow the rules and laws of the nation they take place inn.
3. Both parties must willingly agree to the value of the exange without force of any cind.

[u][b]The Camel Agreement[/b][/u]

1. Nordiheim svears an oath to acknowledge the consumtion of camel meat as illigal and an affront to Alkiragunyan religios and cultural values.
2a. This oath can only be ignored if the alternative to eating camel meat is death by starvation.
2b. When it is to be considered if the eating of camel meat whas a mather of life or death in a court of law, official representatives from Alkiragunya must be allowed to see and have access to all evidence.

[u][b]Cultural Exange[/b][/u]

Both nations are encouraged to learn more about each other, and any learned/wise man or scholar is to be given safe passage into the other nation if they want to aid in this.

[u][b]Decleration of Friendship and Cooperation[/b][/u]

1. Both nations will swear an oath of friendship and coopertaion in mutual benefit, in defence, independence and economy.
2. Both nations obligates themself to first try and resolve any national discourse and disagreements through peacefull means first
3. Both nations will respect and acknowledge eachothers sovereign land and independence
4. Both nations will support the other in defencive wars through either material or direct military action (depending on what the defending nation ask for).
5. Both nations are obligated to comunicate and consider the effect(s) that there foreign actions and deals with other nations will have on the other, when that effect is a nagative one.
